dedupe_keys.name: 名古屋市 津波ハサートマッフ tsunami and disaster risk and hazard maps

description: 【名古屋市】津波ハザードマップ [tsunami and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 名古屋市. 令和元年7月に愛知県が指定した津波災害警戒区域や浸水開始時間を示したものです。 千年に一度あるいはそれよりもっと発生頻度は低いものの、発生すれば甚大な被害をもたらす最大クラスの津波を想定しています。. Coverage: 名古屋市. The portal files it under the publisher 名古屋市. Its tags are ハザードマップ, 名古屋市, 防災. It offers 3 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2026-06-01 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
